claims.claim_text_normalized: Mask R-CNN extends Faster R-CNN by adding a branch for predicting an object mask in parallel with the existing branch for bounding box recognition.
claims.evidence_quote_short: Mask R-CNN extends Faster R-CNN by adding a branch for predicting an object mask in parallel with the existing branch for bounding box recognition.

claims.claim_text_normalized: Mask R-CNN runs at 5 frames per second.
claims.evidence_quote_short: Mask R-CNN is simple to train and adds only a small overhead to Faster R-CNN, running at 5 fps.

claims.claim_text_normalized: Mask R-CNN outperforms all existing single-model entries on every COCO challenge task.
claims.evidence_quote_short: Without bells and whistles, Mask R-CNN outperforms all existing, single-model entries on every task, including the COCO 2016 challenge winners.

claims.claim_text_normalized: The RoIAlign layer improves mask accuracy by relative 10% to 50% compared to RoIPool.
claims.evidence_quote_short: RoIAlign has a large impact: it improves mask accuracy by relative 10% to 50%, showing bigger gains under stricter localization metrics.

claims.claim_text_normalized: Decoupling mask and class prediction is essential for good instance segmentation results.
claims.evidence_quote_short: we found it essential to decouple mask and class prediction

claims.claim_text_normalized: Mask R-CNN surpasses the winner of the 2016 COCO keypoint competition.
claims.evidence_quote_short: Mask R-CNN surpasses the winner of the 2016 COCO keypoint competition

claims.claim_text_normalized: FCIS exhibits systematic errors on overlapping instances.
claims.evidence_quote_short: FCIS exhibits systematic errors on overlapping instances and creates spurious edges

claims.claim_text_normalized: Training Mask R-CNN on COCO takes one to two days on a single 8-GPU machine.
claims.evidence_quote_short: training on COCO takes one to two days on a single 8-GPU machine.
